fruits.extendedStory: Bishop Severin was leading his people through the streets, singing, when the choir was heard, so the tale goes. The ground beneath has its own story. It was once a Rhine island. Digs under the church found a Roman sports ground, with a pool of 34 by 17 metres. Its remains are still easy to see by the foundations of the church's rounded north end. Later came monks called Scottish, known for their strict rule. Whether they really came from Scotland is still an open question.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Bischof Severin führte gerade singend seine Gläubigen durch die Straßen, als der Chor erklang, so erzählt man. Auch der Boden hat seine Geschichte. Er war einmal eine Insel im Rhein. Grabungen unter der Kirche fanden eine römische Sportanlage mit einem Schwimmbecken von 34 mal 17 Metern. Seine Reste sind am Fundament des runden Nordarms der Kirche noch gut zu erkennen. Später kamen schottische Mönche, bekannt für ihre strenge Regel. Ob sie wirklich aus Schottland stammten, ist bis heute offen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Bishop Severin was leading his people through the streets, singing, when the choir was heard, so the tale goes. The ground beneath has its own story. It was once a Rhine island. Digs under the church found a Roman sports ground, with a pool of 34 by 17 metres. Its remains are still easy to see by the foundations of the church's rounded north end. Later came monks called Scottish, known for their strict rule. Whether they really came from Scotland is still an open question.

localizedStory.de: Der Sage nach sang hier an einem 11. November ein Engelschor, als Bischof Martin von Tours starb. Ihm zu Ehren, heißt es, entstand die Kirche.
localizedStory.en: The story goes that a heavenly choir sang here one 11 November as Bishop Martin of Tours died. They say the church rose for him.

fruits.name: Groß Sankt Martin
fruits.story: The story goes that a heavenly choir sang here one 11 November as Bishop Martin of Tours died. They say the church rose for him.

fruits.extendedStory: The story goes that Charlemagne told his three sons to open their mouths wide. The two who did, it is said, each got a piece of apple. With it, so the tale goes, came a share of his empire, and the son who refused got nothing. The face stands for the craft guilds, who built this tower as a sign that they now ruled the city. Old documents call this place a house in which the citizens gather, which makes it Germany's oldest documented town hall.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Sage nach forderte Karl der Große seine drei Söhne auf, den Mund weit zu öffnen. Die beiden, die gehorchten, bekamen, so heißt es, je ein Stück Apfel. Damit erhielten sie, so die Geschichte, einen Teil seines Reiches, der dritte ging leer aus. Die Fratze steht für die Zünfte, die diesen Turm als Zeichen ihrer Herrschaft über die Stadt bauen ließen. Alte Urkunden nennen den Ort ein Haus, in dem die Bürger zusammenkommen. Damit ist es das älteste bezeugte Rathaus Deutschlands.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The story goes that Charlemagne told his three sons to open their mouths wide. The two who did, it is said, each got a piece of apple. With it, so the tale goes, came a share of his empire, and the son who refused got nothing. The face stands for the craft guilds, who built this tower as a sign that they now ruled the city. Old documents call this place a house in which the citizens gather, which makes it Germany's oldest documented town hall.

localizedStory.de: Zu jeder vollen Stunde streckt die Fratze am Turm die Zunge heraus. Der Sage nach gewinnt Macht, wer im richtigen Moment den Mund öffnet.
localizedStory.en: Every hour, the carved face on the tower sticks out its tongue. Legend says whoever opens their mouth at the right moment wins power.

fruits.name: Historisches Rathaus
fruits.story: Every hour, the carved face on the tower sticks out its tongue. Legend says whoever opens their mouth at the right moment wins power.

fruits.extendedStory: The story goes that the cathedral's plan came from the Virgin Mary. As Albertus Magnus prayed in his cell, the tale goes, master builders with golden crowns stepped in. At her word, it is said, they drew a mighty church in shining lines. The fame of the Three Kings, whose bones came here from Milan, gave the decisive push to build it. While the building stood unfinished, its medieval crane sat on the south tower stump, almost the city's landmark. It came down in 1868, and the cathedral was not finished until 1880.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Sage nach stammt der Plan des Doms von der Jungfrau Maria. Als Albertus Magnus in seiner Zelle betete, traten, so erzählt man, Meister mit goldenen Kronen ein. Auf ihr Geheiß zeichneten sie, heißt es, in leuchtenden Linien eine prächtige Kirche. Der Ruhm der Heiligen Drei Könige, deren Gebeine aus Mailand hierherkamen, gab den entscheidenden Anstoß zum Neubau. Während der Dom unfertig dastand, stand sein mittelalterlicher Baukran auf dem Stumpf des Südturms, fast das Wahrzeichen der Stadt. Abgebaut wurde er 1868, vollendet war der Dom erst 1880.

At her word, it is said, they drew a mighty church in shining lines. The fame of the Three Kings, whose bones came here from Milan, gave the decisive push to build it. While the building stood unfinished, its medieval crane sat on the south tower stump, almost the city's landmark. It came down in 1868, and the cathedral was not finished until 1880.

localizedStory.de: Such Gerhard Richters Fenster im Südquerhaus. Ein Zufallsgenerator hat seine 72 Farben verteilt, und die eine Hälfte spiegelt die andere.
localizedStory.en: Find Gerhard Richter's window in the south transept. A random generator placed its 72 colours, and one half is the other's mirror image.

fruits.name: Kölner Dom
fruits.story: Find Gerhard Richter's window in the south transept. A random generator placed its 72 colours, and one half is the other's mirror image.

fruits.extendedStory: The legend goes that Wilhelm Mülhens got the recipe for his scent as a wedding present, from a friend, a Carthusian monk. The recipe, it is said, is still a secret today. Mülhens bought the house in 1796 and used its catchy number to set his Eau de Cologne apart. Listen up on the hour. The carillon's 20 bells play from the facade while historical figures parade past, and the Marseillaise is always one of the tunes.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Legende nach schenkte ein befreundeter Kartäusermönch Wilhelm Mülhens das Rezept zur Hochzeit, und es soll bis heute geheim sein. Mülhens kaufte das Haus 1796 und hob sein Kölnisch Wasser mit der einprägsamen Nummer von der Konkurrenz ab. Hör zur vollen Stunde hin. Dann spielen die 20 Glocken an der Fassade, historische Figuren ziehen vorbei, und die Marseillaise ist immer dabei.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The legend goes that Wilhelm Mülhens got the recipe for his scent as a wedding present, from a friend, a Carthusian monk. The recipe, it is said, is still a secret today. Mülhens bought the house in 1796 and used its catchy number to set his Eau de Cologne apart. Listen up on the hour. The carillon's 20 bells play from the facade while historical figures parade past, and the Marseillaise is always one of the tunes.

localizedStory.de: Dieser Duft heißt nach einer Hausnummer. Französische Truppen ließen alle Kölner Häuser durchnummerieren, und das Haus in der Glockengasse bekam zufällig die 4711.
localizedStory.en: This scent is named after a house number. French troops numbered every house in Cologne, and the house in the Glockengasse got 4711 by chance.

fruits.name: Dufthaus 4711
fruits.story: This scent is named after a house number. French troops numbered every house in Cologne, and the house in the Glockengasse got 4711 by chance.

fruits.extendedStory: Since about 2008, hundreds of thousands of locks have been fixed here. Around 1,500 trains a day can cross, and it counts as the most used railway bridge in Germany. Four equestrian statues flank the ramps on both banks. They show Prussian kings and German emperors of the Hohenzollern family, and the bridge is named after them.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Seit etwa 2008 wurden hier hunderttausende Schlösser angebracht. Um die 1.500 Züge können täglich über die Brücke rollen, und sie gilt als die meistbefahrene Eisenbahnbrücke Deutschlands. An beiden Ufern flankieren vier Reiterstandbilder die Rampen. Sie zeigen preußische Könige und deutsche Kaiser aus der Familie der Hohenzollern, nach der die Brücke benannt ist.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Since about 2008, hundreds of thousands of locks have been fixed here. Around 1,500 trains a day can cross, and it counts as the most used railway bridge in Germany. Four equestrian statues flank the ramps on both banks. They show Prussian kings and German emperors of the Hohenzollern family, and the bridge is named after them.

localizedStory.de: Schau auf die Geländer. Man erzählt, Paare hängen hier ein Liebesschloss mit Namen oder Initialen auf und werfen den Schlüssel in den Rhein.
localizedStory.en: Look at the railings. People say couples fix a love lock here with their names or initials, then throw the key into the Rhine.

fruits.name: Hohenzollernbrücke
fruits.story: Look at the railings. People say couples fix a love lock here with their names or initials, then throw the key into the Rhine.

fruits.extendedStory: The tale says she had seemed dead but sat up. She walked home in the night, it is said, and knocked at the door. Look for the Richmodishaus near the square. Two horse heads still look out of its tower windows, in memory of that night. The square itself is the largest of about 30 in Cologne. On the roof of the Neumarkt Galerie sits Claes Oldenburg's Dropped Cone, a giant ice cream cone more than 12 metres tall.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Man erzählt, sie sei nur scheintot gewesen und habe sich aufgerichtet. Dann sei sie in der Nacht heimgelaufen und habe an die Tür geklopft. Such das Richmodishaus nahe dem Platz. Aus seinen Turmfenstern schauen bis heute zwei Pferdeköpfe, zur Erinnerung an diese Nacht. Von etwa 30 Plätzen in Köln ist der Neumarkt der größte. Auf dem Dach der Neumarkt Galerie sitzt Claes Oldenburgs Dropped Cone, eine Eistüte, mehr als 12 Meter hoch.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tale says she had seemed dead but sat up. She walked home in the night, it is said, and knocked at the door. Look for the Richmodishaus near the square. Two horse heads still look out of its tower windows, in memory of that night. The square itself is the largest of about 30 in Cologne. On the roof of the Neumarkt Galerie sits Claes Oldenburg's Dropped Cone, a giant ice cream cone more than 12 metres tall.

localizedStory.de: Der Sage nach schwor Mengis, eher stiegen seine Schimmel in den Turm, als dass seine totgeglaubte Frau Richmodis heimkehre. Beides geschah, so die Sage.
localizedStory.en: Legend says Mengis swore his white horses would climb the tower before Richmodis, his wife thought dead, came home. That night, they say, both happened.

fruits.name: Neumarkt
fruits.story: Legend says Mengis swore his white horses would climb the tower before Richmodis, his wife thought dead, came home. That night, they say, both happened.

fruits.extendedStory: Nobody knows for sure where the name Hahnentor comes from. It may be a landowner called Hageno. Or it may come from Hano, a name for a wooden gate, because woods lined the road to Aachen. Built early in the 13th century, it guarded the way west. Kings crowned in Aachen entered the city here, heading on to the Three Kings' shrine in the cathedral. And in a Micky Maus comic, the gate was once the Beagle Boys' headquarters.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Keiner weiß genau, woher der Name Hahnentor kommt. Vielleicht von einem Grundbesitzer namens Hageno. Vielleicht auch von Hano, einem Holztor, weil am Weg nach Aachen Wälder lagen. Anfang des 13. Jahrhunderts erbaut, sicherte es den Weg nach Westen. Könige, die in Aachen gekrönt waren, zogen hier in die Stadt und weiter zum Dreikönigsschrein im Dom. Und im Micky-Maus-Magazin war das Tor einmal das Hauptquartier der Panzerknacker.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Nobody knows for sure where the name Hahnentor comes from. It may be a landowner called Hageno. Or it may come from Hano, a name for a wooden gate, because woods lined the road to Aachen. Built early in the 13th century, it guarded the way west. Kings crowned in Aachen entered the city here, heading on to the Three Kings' shrine in the cathedral. And in a Micky Maus comic, the gate was once the Beagle Boys' headquarters.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Tor hatte einst die Hausnummer 5283 ½. Das halbe stand für ein öffentliches Gebäude, und das zahlte keine Steuern.
localizedStory.en: This gate once had the house number 5283 and a half. The half marked a public building, so it paid no tax.

fruits.name: Hahnentorburg
fruits.story: This gate once had the house number 5283 and a half. The half marked a public building, so it paid no tax.

fruits.extendedStory: Just its lowest courses and foundations are Roman. The upper part was built up again later, so people can see how it looked. It once belonged to the convent of the Poor Clares, an order of nuns. An entry in a Cologne property register from 1386 suggests the nuns probably used it as their toilet. The tower was uncovered after the Second World War, and its green patch has shaped the streets beside it ever since.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Nur die unteren Lagen und die Fundamente sind römisch. Der obere Teil wurde später wieder aufgebaut, damit man sieht, wie er aussah. Einst gehörte er zum Kloster der Klarissen, einem Nonnenorden. Ein Eintrag in einem Kölner Grundbuch von 1386 lässt vermuten, dass die Nonnen ihn wohl als Toilette nutzten. Freigelegt wurde der Turm nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, und sein grünes Umfeld prägt seither die Straßen daneben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Just its lowest courses and foundations are Roman. The upper part was built up again later, so people can see how it looked. It once belonged to the convent of the Poor Clares, an order of nuns. An entry in a Cologne property register from 1386 suggests the nuns probably used it as their toilet. The tower was uncovered after the Second World War, and its green patch has shaped the streets beside it ever since.

localizedStory.de: Geh einmal um diesen römischen Mauerturm herum. Er ist nur ein halber Turm, und schon zur Römerzeit stand seine Seite zur Stadt hin offen.
localizedStory.en: Walk round this Roman wall tower. It is just half a tower, and even in Roman times its side facing the town stood open.

fruits.name: Helenenturm
fruits.story: Walk round this Roman wall tower. It is just half a tower, and even in Roman times its side facing the town stood open.
